name: Smart Video Scheduler
intro: Smart Video Scheduler is an early page for publishing a video to your social accounts. Its Publish tab opens Publish to Social, and a post goes out right away.

features.calendar-tab: The Calendar tab is open when the page loads. It is a placeholder for a future calendar of your posts.
features.publish-tab: The Publish tab has a Publish to Social button. It opens the window where you add your video, create a thumbnail, write the copy and publish to a connected account right away.
features.analytics-tab: The Analytics tab previews the area where you'll track how your posts perform across platforms.

outro: That's the scheduler. Publish from the Publish tab, and your post goes out right away.
